        <div class="td-content">
          
            <h1>Install mesheryctl</h1>
          
          <p>Meshery&rsquo;s command line client is <code>mesheryctl</code> and is the recommended tool for configuring and deploying one or more Meshery deployments. To install <code>mesheryctl</code> on your system, you may choose from any of the following supported methods.</p>
<p><code>mesheryctl</code> can be installed via <a href="/v0.9/installation/linux-mac/bash/">bash</a>, <a href="/v0.9/installation/linux-mac/brew/">Homebrew</a>, <a href="/v0.9/installation/windows/scoop/">Scoop</a> or <a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/latest">directly downloaded</a>.</p>
<div class="alert alert-info" role="alert"><div class="h4 alert-heading" role="heading">NOTE</div>
<p>Mesheryctl is configured for Kubernetes by default. To specify a different supported platform, use the <code>-p</code> flag.</p>
</div>
<h1 id="install-meshery-cli-with-brew">
	Install Meshery CLI with Brew
</h1>
<h3 id="prerequisites">
	Prerequisites
</h3>
<p>You need to have <code>Brew</code> installed on your <strong>Linux</strong> or <strong>macOS</strong> system to perform these actions.</p>
<h3 id="install-mesheryctl-using-brew">
	Install <code>mesheryctl</code> using Brew
</h3>
<p>To install <code>mesheryctl</code> using homebrew, execute the following commands.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">
 $ brew install mesheryctl
 </div></div>
</pre>
<p>You&rsquo;re ready to run Meshery. To do so, execute the following command.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">
 $ mesheryctl system start

</div></div>
</pre>
<p>If you are running Meshery on Docker, execute the following command.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">
 $ mesheryctl system start -p docker

</div></div>
</pre>
<p>Meshery server supports customizing authentication flow callback URL, which can be configured in the following way</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">
 $ MESHERY_SERVER_CALLBACK_URL=https://custom-host mesheryctl system start

</div></div>
</pre>
<p><code>mesheryctl</code> uses your current Kubernetes context, your KUBECONFIG environment variable (<code>~/.kube/config</code> by default). Confirm if this Kubernetes cluster you want Meshery to interact with by running the following command: <code>kubectl config get-contexts</code>.</p>
<p>If there are multiple contexts in your kubeconfig file, specify the one you want to use with the <code>use-context</code> subcommand: <code>kubectl config use-context &lt;context-to-use&gt;</code>.</p>
<h3 id="upgrade-mesheryctl-using-brew">
	Upgrade <code>mesheryctl</code> using Brew
</h3>
<p>To upgrade <code>mesheryctl</code>, execute the following command.</p>
 <pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">
 $ brew upgrade mesheryctl
 </div></div>
 </pre>
<details>
<summary>
Example output of a successful upgrade.
</summary>
<pre><code>
➜  ~ brew upgrade mesheryctl
==> Upgrading 1 outdated package:
meshery/tap/mesheryctl 0.3.2 -> 0.3.4
==> Upgrading meshery/tap/mesheryctl
==> Downloading https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/download/v0.3.4/mesheryctl_0.3.4_Darwin_x86_64.zip
==> Downloading from https://github-production-release-asset-2e65be.s3.amazonaws.com/157554479/17522b00-2af0-11ea-8aef-cbfe8
######################################################################## 100.0%
🍺  /usr/local/Cellar/mesheryctl/0.3.4: 5 files, 10.2MB, built in 4 seconds
Removing: /usr/local/Cellar/mesheryctl/0.3.2... (5 files, 10.2MB)
Removing: /Users/lee/Library/Caches/Homebrew/mesheryctl--0.3.2.zip... (3.9MB)
==> Checking for dependents of upgraded formulae...
==> No dependents found!
</code></pre>
<br />
</details>
<h1 id="install-meshery-cli-with-bash">
	Install Meshery CLI with Bash
</h1>
<p>To install or upgrade <code>mesheryctl</code> using <code>bash</code>, execute anyone of the following commands.</p>
<h4 id="option-1-only-install-mesheryctl-binary">
	Option 1: Only install <code>mesheryctl</code> binary
</h4>
 <pre class="codeblock-pre">
 <div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">
  $ curl -L https://meshery.io/install | DEPLOY_MESHERY=false bash -
 </div></div>
 </pre>
<br />
<br />
#### Option 2: Install `mesheryctl` binary and deploy Meshery on Docker
 <pre class="codeblock-pre">
 <div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">
  $ curl -L https://meshery.io/install | PLATFORM=docker bash -
 </div></div>
 </pre>
<br />
<br />
#### Option 3: Install `mesheryctl` binary and deploy Meshery on Kubernetes
 <pre class="codeblock-pre">
 <div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">
  $ curl -L https://meshery.io/install | PLATFORM=kubernetes bash -
 </div></div>
 </pre>
<br />
<br />
#### Option 4: Install `mesheryctl` binary and Meshery adapter(s)
<p>Install <code>mesheryctl</code> binary and include one or more <a href="/v0.9/concepts/architecture/adapters/">adapters</a> to be deployed</p>
 <pre class="codeblock-pre">
 <div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">
  $ curl -L https://meshery.io/install | ADAPTERS=consul PLATFORM=kubernetes bash -
 </div></div>
 </pre>
<br />
<br />
### Start Meshery
You are ready to deploy Meshery `mesheryctl`. To do so, execute the following command.
 <pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl system start</div></div>
 </pre>
<p>If you are running Meshery on Docker, execute the following command.</p>
 <pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl system start -p docker</div></div>
 </pre>
<h1 id="install-meshery-cli-with-scoop">
	Install Meshery CLI with Scoop
</h1>
<h2 id="prerequisites-1">
	Prerequisites
</h2>
<p>You need to have <code>scoop</code> installed on your Windows system to perform these actions.</p>
<h3 id="install-mesheryctl-with-scoop">
	Install <code>mesheryctl</code> with Scoop
</h3>
<p>To install <code>mesheryctl</code> using Scoop, execute the following commands.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">scoop bucket add mesheryctl https://github.com/meshery/scoop-bucket.git
scoop install mesheryctl</div></div>
</pre>
<p>You&rsquo;re ready to run Meshery. To do so, execute the following command.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl system start</div></div>
</pre>
<p>If you are running Meshery on Docker, execute the following command.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl system start -p docker</div></div>
</pre>
<h3 id="upgrade-mesheryctl-with-scoop">
	Upgrade <code>mesheryctl</code> with Scoop
</h3>
<p>To upgrade <code>mesheryctl</code>, execute the following command.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">scoop update mesheryctl</div></div>
</pre>
<p>Continue deploying Meshery onto one of the <a href="/v0.9/installation/">Supported Platforms</a>.</p>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
            <h1>Using Multiple Adapters</h1>
          
          <h2 id="advanced-configuration">
	Advanced Configuration
</h2>
<p>Meshery is capable of running zero or more adapters. Meshery offers many features without the need for adapters. Adapters are optional components that enhance and extend Meshery&rsquo;s core functionality.</p>
<h3 id="modifying-the-default-adapter-deployment-configuration">
	Modifying the default adapter deployment configuration
</h3>
<p>The number of adapters, type of adapters, where they are deployed, how they are named and what port they are exposed on are all configurable deployment options. To modify the default configuration, find <code>~/.meshery/meshery.yaml</code> on your system. <code>~/.meshery/meshery.yaml</code> is a Docker Compose file.</p>
<h4 id="configuration-running-fewer-meshery-adapters">
	Configuration: Running fewer Meshery adapters
</h4>
<p>To customize which Meshery Adapters are used in which deployments, customize your contexts in your meshconfig.</p>
<p><em>Recommended:</em>
Configure your meshconfig using <code>mesheryctl system context</code> to customize which Meshery Adapters are used in which deployments.</p>
<p><em>Alternative:</em>
Alternatively, directly modify the <code>~/.meshery/meshery.yaml</code> configuration file, removing the entries for any adapters you want to remove from your deployment.</p>
<h4 id="configuration-running-more-than-one-instance-of-the-same-meshery-adapter">
	Configuration: Running more than one instance of the same Meshery adapter
</h4>
<p>The default configuration of a Meshery deployment includes one instance of each of the Meshery Adapters (that have reached a stable version status). You may choose to run multiple instances of the same type of Meshery Adapter; for example, two instances of the Meshery Adapter for NGINX Service Mesh. To do so, you can use either of Meshery&rsquo;s clients to modify your Meshery deployment:</p>
<ul>
<li>Using <code>mesheryctl</code>, modify <code>~/.meshery/meshery.yaml</code> to include multiple copies of the given adapter.</li>
<li>Using Meshery UI, navigate to the Settings page and enter the host and port of your additional adapter.</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="configuration-choosing-an-adapter-while-installing-mesheryctl">
	Configuration: Choosing an adapter while installing Mesheryctl
</h4>
<p>When installing <code>mesheryctl</code> using the Bash installation script, you can choose which adapters to load.
Do so by passing the <code>ADAPTERS</code> environment variable to the Meshery Bash script.</p>
<p><em>For example:</em>
<code>curl -L https://meshery.io/install | ADAPTERS=consul PLATFORM=kubernetes bash -</code> installs <code>mesheryctl</code> and starts Meshery Server in your connected Kubernetes cluster, deploying only the Meshery Adapter for Consul and not the rest of Meshery&rsquo;s adapters.</p>
<h5>Demo of Meshery managing deployments across multiple Kubernetes clusters:</h5>
<iframe class="container" width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/yWPu3vq4vEs?start=5041" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen></iframe>
<p>See on YouTube: <a href="https://youtu.be/yWPu3vq4vEs?t=5041&amp;list=PL3A-A6hPO2IOpTbdH89qR-4AE0ON13Zie">Cloud Native Austin Virtual Meetup: April 2020</a></p>

        </div>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

            <h1>Meshery Playground</h1>
          
          <p><em>Try out Meshery Playground at <a href="https://playground.meshery.io/">https://playground.meshery.io/</a></em></p>
<p>Meshery Playground is a web-based, collaborative environment that lets you explore Meshery as a cloud native manager and all of the infrastructure it manages, including multiple Kubernetes clusters, CNCF projects and applications, services, and operators that run on Kubernetes. Meshery Playground provides a sandboxed environment to experiment with different infrastructure configurations and deployment options. Its multiplayer plugins allow you to collaborate in real time with your teammates on infrastructure design and operation.</p>
<p>With Meshery Playground, you can:</p>
<ul>
<li>Collaborate with other engineers, share your knowledge, and exchange ideas</li>
<li>Explore new cloud native tools without the need for complex setup or configuration. Simply open your browser and go.</li>
<li>Design new cloud native scenarios and easily deploy them in the Playground environment. Keep your designs and deploy them in your own environment when you’re ready.</li>
</ul>
<p>You can interactively explore all kinds of cloud native infrastructure and do so without having to install them on your local machine. You can create virtual services and deploy sample applications and observe their behavior in real-time.</p>
<p>Meshery Playground also has pre-built scenarios that demonstrate how to implement specific use cases such as traffic splitting, circuit breaking, and other cloud native patterns.</p>
<h2 id="meshery-playground-faq">
	Meshery Playground FAQ
</h2>
<h4 id="question-why-do-i-need-to-sign-up-or-register-to-use-meshery-playground">
	Question: Why do I need to sign up or register to use Meshery Playground?
</h4>
<p><strong>Answer:</strong> <em>The Playground is connected to live Kubernetes clusters. While these clusters are refreshed on a daily basis, they do need to be protected from nefarious actors who might use these clusters for cryptomining, for example.</em></p>
<p><em>Sign up to receive a user account with perpetually free, full access to the Playground environment.</em></p>
<p><em>The Meshery Playground is connected to live Kubernetes cluster(s) and allows users full control over those clusters. Requiring users to register a user account keeps the Playground safe and healthy for all to enjoy. Without requiring users to sign in, the Meshery Playground would allow anonymous access for anyone and everyone to potentially perform nefarious acts.</em></p>
<h4 id="question-will-i-lose-my-meshery-designs-in-the-cloud-native-playground">
	Question: Will I lose my Meshery designs in the Cloud Native Playground?
</h4>
<p><strong>Answer:</strong> <em>No, all of the designs that you have created in the Meshery Playground are saved to your user account and will be available to you each time you sign in to your account. Your designs will be available in the Meshery Playground and any of your other Meshery deployments, too.</em></p>
<p><em>In other words, all work done in  Designer is persisted to your user account.</em></p>
<h4 id="question-will-i-lose-my-meshery-deployments-in-the-cloud-native-playground">
	Question: Will I lose my Meshery deployments in the Cloud Native Playground?
</h4>
<p><strong>Answer:</strong> <em>Yes, the Meshery Playground clusters are reset on a daily basis. However, only deployments (not designs) that you may have created will be lost.</em></p>
<p><em>In other words, only  Visualizer is reset. All of your work in Meshery UI and  Designer will remain in your user account.</em></p>
<h4 id="question-is-there-a-demo-user-account-that-everyone-can-use">
	Question: Is there a demo user account that everyone can use?
</h4>
<p><strong>Answer:</strong> <em>It is imperative that each user has their own account to ensure seamless real-time collaboration within the Playground. The use of individual accounts is critical to enable multiple people to access and utilize the powerful collaboration features.</em></p>
<p><em>Creating your own account ensures that any designs you create or save will be stored and accessible across sessions, preventing any loss of work.</em></p>
<p><em>To ensure accountability in the Playground, it&rsquo;s crucial to promote the use of individual named accounts. This helps prevent bad actors from hiding behind anonymous general-use accounts and maliciously abusing the Playground. Therefore, the use of named accounts is an essential step towards achieving this goal.</em></p>
<h4 id="question-can-i-deploy-meshery-on-premises">
	Question: Can I deploy Meshery on-premises?
</h4>
<p><strong>Answer:</strong> <em>Yes, Meshery can be deployed on-premises with a single command to download, install, and run your own instance of Meshery in your environment. See all supported platforms to deploy your own Meshery instance at <a href="/v0.9/installation/">https://docs.meshery.io/installation</a>.</em></p>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
            <h1>Quick Start Guide</h1>
          
          <p><a name="getting-started"></a></p>
<p>Getting Meshery up and running locally on a Docker-enabled system or in Kubernetes is easy. Meshery deploys as a set of Docker containers, which can be deployed to either a Docker host or Kubernetes cluster.</p>
<div class="alert alert-warning" role="alert"><div class="h4 alert-heading" role="heading">Quick Start Assumptions</div>
<p>This quick start guide enables you to download, install, and run Meshery in a single command. See all <a href='/installation'>supported platforms</a> for more specific (and less presumptuous) instructions.</p>
</div>
<h2 id="1-download-install-and-run-meshery">
	1. Download, install, and run Meshery
</h2>
<p>If you are on a macOS or Linux system, you can download, install, and run both <code>mesheryctl</code> and Meshery Server by executing the following command.</p>
<!-- <pre class="codeblock-pre" style="padding: 0; font-size:0px;">
<div class="codeblock" style="display: block;">
  <div class="clipboardjs" style="visibility:hidden;padding: 0;">
    <span style="visibility:hidden">curl -L https://meshery.io/install | PLATFORM=kubernetes bash -</span>
  </div>
  <div class="window-buttons"></div>
  <div id="termynal0" style="width:fit-content;min-height:content-fit;" data-termynal="">
    <span data-ty="input">curl -L https://meshery.io/install | PLATFORM=kubernetes bash -</span>
  </div>
</div>
</pre>-->
<!-- <script src="/assets/js/terminal.js" data-termynal-container="#termynal0"></script> -->
<pre class="codeblock-pre">
  <div class="codeblock">
  <div class="clipboardjs">curl -L https://meshery.io/install | PLATFORM=kubernetes bash -</div>
  </div>
</pre>
<div class="alert alert-info" role="alert"><div class="h4 alert-heading" role="heading">Meshery CLI</div>
<p>Meshery&rsquo;s command line interface, <code>mesheryctl</code>, can be installed in <a href='/installation/mesheryctl'>various ways</a>. In addition to <a href='/installation/linux-mac/bash'>Bash</a>, you can also use <a href='/installation/linux-mac/brew'>Brew</a> or <a href='/installation/windows/scoop'>Scoop</a> to install <code>mesheryctl</code>. Alternatively, <code>mesheryctl</code> is also available via <a href='https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/latest'>direct download</a>.</p>
</div>
<h2 id="2-access-meshery">
	2. Access Meshery
</h2>
<p>Your default browser will be opened and directed to Meshery&rsquo;s web-based user interface typically found at <code>http://localhost:9081</code>.</p>
<div class="alert alert-light" role="alert"><div class="h4 alert-heading" role="heading">Accessing Meshery Server with Meshery UI</div>
<p>Meshery&rsquo;s web-based user interface is embedded in Meshery Server and is available as soon as Meshery starts. The location and port that Meshery UI is exposed varies depending upon your mode of deployment. See <a href='/installation/accessing-meshery-ui'>accessing Meshery UI</a> for deployment-specific details.</p>
</div>
<div class="alert alert-light" role="alert"><div class="h4 alert-heading" role="heading">Accessing Meshery Server with Meshery CLI</div>
<p>Meshery&rsquo;s command line interface is a client of Meshery Server&rsquo;s REST API (just as Meshery UI is). Choose to use <code>mesheryctl</code> as an alternative client as it suits your needs.</p>
</div>
<h2 id="3-select-a-provider">
	3. Select a Provider
</h2>
<p>Select from the list of <a href="/v0.9/extensibility/providers/">Providers</a> in order to log in to Meshery. Authenticate with your chosen Provider.</p>
<a href="./images/meshery-server-page.png">
  <img class="center" style="width:min(100%,650px)" src="./images/meshery-server-page.png" />
</a>
<h2 id="4-configure-connections-to-your-kubernetes-clusters">
	4. Configure Connections to your Kubernetes Clusters
</h2>
<p><strong>Out-of-Cluster Deployments</strong>
If you have deployed Meshery out-of-cluster, Meshery Server will automatically attempt to connect to any available Kubernetes clusters found in your kubeconfig (under <code>$HOME/.kube/config</code>) and in kubeconfigs uploaded through Meshery UI. Meshery Server deploys <a href="/v0.9/concepts/architecture/operator/">Meshery Operator</a>, <a href="/v0.9/concepts/architecture/meshsync/">MeshSync</a>, and Broker into the <code>meshery</code> namespace (by default).</p>
<p><strong>In-Cluster Deployments</strong>
If you have deployed Meshery in-cluster, Meshery Server will automatically connect to the Kubernetes API Server available in the control plane.</p>
<p>Visit <i class="fas fa-cog"></i> Settings:</p>
<a href="./images/meshery-settings.png">
  <img class="center" style="width:min(100%,650px);" src="./images/meshery-settings.png" />
</a>
<p>If your config has not been autodetected, you can manually upload your kubeconfig file (or any number of kubeconfig files). By default, Meshery will attempt to connect to and deploy Meshery Operator to each reachable context contained in the imported kubeconfig files. See <a href="/v0.9/installation/kubernetes/">Managing Kubernetes Clusters</a> for more information.</p>
<h2 id="5-verify-deployment">
	5. Verify Deployment
</h2>
<p>Run connectivity tests and verify the health of your Meshery system. Verify Meshery&rsquo;s connection to your Kubernetes clusters by clicking on the connection chip. A quick connectivity test will run and inform you of Meshery&rsquo;s ability to reach and authenticate to your Kubernetes control plane(s). You will be notified of your connection status. You can also verify any other connection between Meshery and either its components (like <a href="/v0.9/concepts/architecture/adapters/">Meshery Adapters</a>) or other managed infrastructure by clicking on any of the connection chips. When clicked, a chip will perform an ad hoc connectivity test.</p>
<a href="./images/k8s-context-switcher.png" alt="Meshery Kubernetes Context Switcher">
  <img class="center" style="width:min(100%,350px);" src="./images/k8s-context-switcher.png" />
</a>
<h2 id="6-design-and-operate-kubernetes-clusters-and-their-workloads">
	6. Design and operate Kubernetes clusters and their workloads
</h2>
<p>You may now proceed to manage any cloud native infrastructure supported by Meshery. See all <a href="/extensibility/integrations">integrations</a> for a complete list of supported infrastructure.</p>
<a href="./images/meshery-designs.png">
  <img class="center" style="width:min(100%,650px);" src="./images/meshery-designs.png" />
</a>
<h2 id="explore-tutorials">
	Explore Tutorials
</h2>
<p>🧑‍🔬 Explore these tutorials to learn how to use Meshery for collaboratively managing infrastructure.</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

	Upgrading Meshery Server, Adapters, and UI
</h2>
<p>Various components of Meshery will need to be upgraded as new releases become available. Meshery is comprised of a number of components including a server, adapters, UI, and CLI. As an application, Meshery is a composition of different functional components.</p>
<p style="text-align:center">
<a href="./images/upgrading-meshery.svg">
    <img src="./images/upgrading-meshery.svg" style="margin: 1rem;" />
</a><br /><i><small>Figure: Meshery components</small></i>
</p>
<p>Some of the components must be upgraded simultaneously, while others may be upgraded independently. The following table depicts components, their versions, and deployment units (deployment groups).</p>
<h3 id="versioning-of-meshery-components">
	Versioning of Meshery components
</h3>
<table class="mesherycomponents">
    <tr>
        <th>Components</th>
        <th>Sub-component</th>
        <th>Considering or Updating</th>
    </tr>
    <tr>
        <td class="childcomponent">Meshery Adapters</td>
        <td>Any and All Adapters</td>
        <td>Docker Deployment: Watchtower updates this component in accordance with the user’s release channel subscription.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
        <td rowspan="3" class="childcomponent">Meshery Server</td>
        <td>Meshery UI</td>
        <td rowspan="3">Manages lifecycle of Meshery Operator; Adapters, UI, Load Generators, Database.<br /><br />
Docker Deployment: Watchtower updates this component in accordance with the user’s release channel subscription.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
        <td>Load Generators</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
        <td>Database</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
        <td rowspan="2" class="childcomponent">Meshery Operator</td>
        <td>MeshSync</td>
        <td>Meshery Operator manages the lifecycle of this component and its sub-components.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
        <td>Meshery Broker</td>
        <td>Meshery Operator manages the lifecycle of this event bus component.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
        <td class="childcomponent">`mesheryctl`</td>
        <td></td>
        <td><code>mesheryctl</code> manages the lifecycle of Meshery Server. <br /><br />
        <ul> 
            <li><code>system start</code> calls system update by default, which updates the server and existing adapters, but doesn’t update <code>meshery.yaml</code>. Unless the <code>skipUpdate</code> flag is used, operators are also updated here.</li>
            <li><code>system reset</code> retrieves <code>docker-compose.yaml</code> from GitHub (use a Git tag to reset to the right Meshery version).</li>
            <li><code>system restart</code> also updates operators, unless the <code>skipUpdate</code> flag is used.</li>
            <li><code>system update</code> updates operators in case of both Docker and Kubernetes deployments.</li>
            <li><code>system context</code> manages <code>config.yaml</code>, which manages <code>meshery.yaml</code>.</li>
            <li><code>mesheryctl</code> should generally check for the latest release and inform the user.</li>
        </ul>
        </td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
        <td rowspan="2" class="childcomponent"><a style="color:white;" href="/extensibility/providers">Remote Providers</a></td>
        <td>Meshery Cloud</td>
        <td>Process Extension: Integrators manage the lifecycle of their Remote Providers. The process is unique per provider.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
        <td>Meshery Extensions</td>
        <td>Static Extension: Integrators manage the lifecycle of their Meshery Extensions. The process is unique per provider.</td>
    </tr>
</table>
<p>Sub-components deploy as a unit; however, they do not share the same version number.</p>
<h3 id="meshery-docker-deployments">
	Meshery Docker Deployments
</h3>
<p>In order to pull the latest images for Meshery Server, Adapters, and UI, execute the following command:</p>
 <pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl system update</div></div>
 </pre>
<p>If you wish to update a running Meshery deployment with the images you just pulled, you&rsquo;ll also have to execute:</p>
 <pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl system restart</div></div>
 </pre>
<h3 id="meshery-kubernetes-deployments">
	Meshery Kubernetes Deployments
</h3>
<p>Use <code>kubectl apply</code> or <code>helm</code> to upgrade the Meshery application manifests in your Kubernetes cluster.</p>
<h2 id="upgrading-meshery-cli">
	Upgrading Meshery CLI
</h2>
<p>The Meshery command-line client, <code>mesheryctl</code>, is available in different package managers. Use the instructions relevant to your environment.</p>
<h3 id="upgrading-mesheryctl-using-homebrew">
	Upgrading <code>mesheryctl</code> using Homebrew
</h3>
<p>To upgrade `mesheryctl`, execute the following command:</p>
 <pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">brew upgrade mesheryctl</div></div>
 </pre>
<h3 id="upgrading-mesheryctl-using-bash">
	Upgrading <code>mesheryctl</code> using Bash
</h3>
<p>Upgrade <code>mesheryctl</code> and run Meshery on Mac or Linux with this script:</p>
 <pre class="codeblock-pre">
 <div class="codeblock"><div class="clipboardjs">curl -L https://meshery.io/install | DEPLOY_MESHERY=false bash -</div></div>
 </pre>
<h3 id="upgrading-mesheryctl-using-scoop">
	Upgrading <code>mesheryctl</code> using Scoop
</h3>
<p>To upgrade <code>mesheryctl</code>, execute the following command:</p>
 <pre class="codeblock-pre">
 <div class="codeblock"><div class="clipboardjs">scoop update mesheryctl</div></div>
 </pre>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
            <h1>Install Meshery CLI on Windows</h1>
          
          
<p>On Windows systems, <code>mesheryctl</code> can be installed via Scoop or <a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/latest">downloaded directly</a>.</p>
<h2 id="prerequisites">
	Prerequisites
</h2>
<p>You need to have <code>scoop</code> installed on your Windows system to perform these actions.</p>
<h3 id="install-mesheryctl-with-scoop">
	Install <code>mesheryctl</code> with Scoop
</h3>
<p>To install <code>mesheryctl</code> using Scoop, execute the following commands.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">scoop bucket add mesheryctl https://github.com/meshery/scoop-bucket.git
scoop install mesheryctl</div></div>
</pre>
<p>You&rsquo;re ready to run Meshery. To do so, execute the following command.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl system start</div></div>
</pre>
<p>If you are running Meshery on Docker, execute the following command.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl system start -p docker</div></div>
</pre>
<h3 id="upgrade-mesheryctl-with-scoop">
	Upgrade <code>mesheryctl</code> with Scoop
</h3>
<p>To upgrade <code>mesheryctl</code>, execute the following command.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">scoop update mesheryctl</div></div>
</pre>
<h2 id="install-mesheryctl-as-a-direct-download">
	Install <code>mesheryctl</code> as a direct download
</h2>
<p>Follow the installation steps to install the <code>mesheryctl</code> CLI. Then, execute:</p>


<pre class="codeblock-pre">
	<div class="codeblock">
		<code class="clipboardjs">./mesheryctl system start</code>
	</div>
</pre>

<p>If you are installing Meshery on Docker, execute the following command:</p>


<pre class="codeblock-pre">
	<div class="codeblock">
		<code class="clipboardjs">./mesheryctl system start -p docker</code>
	</div>
</pre>

<p>Optionally, move the <code>mesheryctl</code> binary to a directory in your <code>PATH</code>.</p>
<!-- Meshery server supports customizing authentication flow callback URL, which can be configured in the following way
  <pre class="codeblock-pre">
  <div class="codeblock"><div class="clipboardjs">MESHERY_SERVER_CALLBACK_URL=https://custom-host ./mesheryctl system start</div></div>
  </pre>

Type `yes` when prompted to choose to configure a file. To get started, choose Docker as your platform to deploy Meshery. -->

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });

      <guid>/v0.9/installation/windows/scoop/</guid>
      <description>&lt;h1 id=&#34;install-meshery-cli-with-scoop&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Install Meshery CLI with Scoop&#xA;&lt;/h1&gt;&#xA;&lt;h2 id=&#34;prerequisites&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Prerequisites&#xA;&lt;/h2&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;You need to have &lt;code&gt;scoop&lt;/code&gt; installed on your Windows system to perform these actions.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;h3 id=&#34;install-mesheryctl-with-scoop&#34;&gt;&#xA;&#x9;Install &lt;code&gt;mesheryctl&lt;/code&gt; with Scoop&#xA;&lt;/h3&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;To install &lt;code&gt;mesheryctl&lt;/code&gt; using Scoop, execute the following commands.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#34;codeblock-pre&#34;&gt;&lt;div class=&#34;codeblock&#34;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#34;clipboardjs&#34;&gt;scoop bucket add mesheryctl https://github.com/meshery/scoop-bucket.git&#xA;scoop install mesheryctl&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;You&amp;rsquo;re ready to run Meshery. To do so, execute the following command.&lt;/p&gt;&#xA;&lt;pre class=&#34;codeblock-pre&#34;&gt;&lt;div class=&#34;codeblock&#34;&gt;&#xA;&lt;div class=&#34;clipboardjs&#34;&gt;mesheryctl system start&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&#xA;&lt;/pre&gt;&#xA;&lt;p&gt;If you are running Meshery on Docker, execute the following command.&lt;/p&gt;</description>
    </item>

          <h1 id="install-meshery-cli-with-scoop">
	Install Meshery CLI with Scoop
</h1>
<h2 id="prerequisites">
	Prerequisites
</h2>
<p>You need to have <code>scoop</code> installed on your Windows system to perform these actions.</p>
<h3 id="install-mesheryctl-with-scoop">
	Install <code>mesheryctl</code> with Scoop
</h3>
<p>To install <code>mesheryctl</code> using Scoop, execute the following commands.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">scoop bucket add mesheryctl https://github.com/meshery/scoop-bucket.git
scoop install mesheryctl</div></div>
</pre>
<p>You&rsquo;re ready to run Meshery. To do so, execute the following command.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl system start</div></div>
</pre>
<p>If you are running Meshery on Docker, execute the following command.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">mesheryctl system start -p docker</div></div>
</pre>
<h3 id="upgrade-mesheryctl-with-scoop">
	Upgrade <code>mesheryctl</code> with Scoop
</h3>
<p>To upgrade <code>mesheryctl</code>, execute the following command.</p>
<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
<div class="clipboardjs">scoop update mesheryctl</div></div>
</pre>
<h1 id="related-reading">
	Related Reading
</h1>

</h2>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
          
            <h1>Meshery Community</h1>
          
          <p>Meshery is a CNCF project maintained by engineers from VMware, Red Hat, Rackspace, Citrix, Instabase, Microsoft, OpenGov, Computas AS, Rill Data, Quantex, Lumina Networks, API7, F5, Citi, Acquia, and HashiCorp. Meshery is an open source project that adheres to the <a href="https://github.com/cncf/foundation/blob/master/code-of-conduct.md">CNCF&rsquo;s Code of Conduct</a>. Meshery advance the state of the art surrounding cloud native management and enable adopters of Cloud Native technologies and techniques to do so with confidence. Our shared commitment to the open source spirit pushes Meshery forward.</p>
<h2 id="getting-involved-in-the-community">
	Getting involved in the Community
</h2>
<p>Get involved with Meshery and supporting projects. Start by reading through the <a href="https://meshery.io/community">Newcomers Guide</a>, which provides details on how to participate. Seek out other community members, who will make sure you are not left out. We always have a role for everyone whether to be a code-writer, a community manager, user, advocate, or just to listen in. The Meshery community is always open and warmly welcomes you.  If this is your first time making open source contribution, you are in the right place!</p>
<p>Please see our <a href="/v0.9/project/contributing/">contributing guide</a> for specific details about setting up your development environment and to start learning the innerworkings of a specific Meshery component.</p>
<h4 id="community-first">
	Community First
</h4>
<p>The Meshery project is community-built and welcomes collaboration! <a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery"><i class="fab fa-github"></i> Fork Meshery</a></p>
<ul>
<li>Join any of the <a href="https://meshery.io/calendar">community meetings</a>.</li>
<li>Subscribe to the <a href="https://meshery.io/calendar">community calendar</a>.</li>
<li>Fill-in a <a href="https://meshery.io/newcomers">community member form</a> to gain access to community resources.</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="talking-about-meshery">
	Talking about Meshery?
</h2>
<p>Giving a talk or hosting a meetup about Meshery? Leverage existing slides or request swag to support your talk.</p>
<div class="wrapper">
    <a href="https://forms.gle/1jqY7HWveSFKCdnD6"><div class="overview">Share your event</div></a>
    <a href="https://meshery.io/newcomers"><div class="overview">Access slides and resources</div></a>
</div>
        </div>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>
